# carbon.create_array { #cflowdist.carbon.create_array }

```python
carbon.create_array(indices, values, shape=None)
```

Create a vector or matrix based on given indices and values,
filling non-mentioned elements with 0.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type          | Description                                                                                                         | Default    |
|---------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| indices | list or array | 1D (for a vector) or 2D (for a matrix) indices.  - Example (1D): [0, 2, 3] - Example (2D): [(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 0)] | _required_ |
| values  | list or array | Values corresponding to the indices.  - Example: [5, 10, 15]                                                        | _required_ |
| shape   | tuple         | Shape of the resulting array. If not provided, the shape is inferred.                                               | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                     |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | A numpy array (vector or matrix) with the specified values and zeros elsewhere. |
